name: Shobab
overview: Shobab was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Cheubai, also known as Caleb, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:18. Beyond his lineage, there are no additional notes or details about his life or role in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Shobab is a proper name meaning 'one who turns back, repents.' This meaning reflects a Hebrew root but was not given directly by God according to the biblical record in 1 Chronicles 2:18.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shobab as the son of Chelubai (Caleb) and Azubah, establishing his immediate family connections. No other familial relationships are documented beyond these in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shobab's significance in the biblical narrative lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah, emphasizing the lineage of Caleb. Though not elaborated upon in Scripture, his mention preserves the heritage and continuity of God's chosen people, which ultimately points toward the fulfillment of God's promises through the tribe of Judah.
